title: No surprises at shift change
brief: Our volunteer clinic loses important details whenever one shift hands work to the next.

target_population.role: volunteer triage coordinator at a free evening clinic
target_population.coverage_limit: one clinic site with two shifts per day; no patient-identifying records of any kind

core_task.summary: publish a signed handoff note that flags one unresolved operational item
core_task.success_oracle: publishing a note with one unresolved flag adds that item to the unresolved queue attributed to the signing volunteer's initials

not_applicable_states.loading: notes and the unresolved queue are seeded local records written synchronously, so publishing never shows an in-flight or spinner frame

state_recipes.empty: resolve both seeded unresolved items; the queue strip collapses to its nothing-carried-over message
state_recipes.validation-error: press publish with the signer initials field blank; an inline error blocks the note
state_recipes.success: flag the glove restock as unresolved, sign with initials, and publish; the queue gains the new item
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the note composer shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the composer at 390x844; the unresolved strip stays pinned above the note field

acceptance_facts: The seed contains four handoff notes and exactly two unresolved items at the 2026-08-12 shift change.
Publishing requires signer initials and stamps the note with its shift name and author.
The unresolved queue shows the oldest item first and names the shift each item originated from.

product_signature.mechanism: unresolved queue that carries flagged items across shifts until someone closes them
product_signature.anchor: unresolved strip pinned above the note composer
product_signature.brief_trace: loses important details whenever one shift hands work to the next
product_signature.counterfactual: a chat log would fit a team messaging brief, but items would scroll away instead of persisting until closed
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the new flag standing in the unresolved queue with the author's initials

anti_goals: no patient records, clinical notes, or medical guidance of any kind
no real-time chat or notification system
no staff scheduling or rota management

content_seed.data_notes: volunteers, notes, and unresolved items are invented operational records; nothing references a patient or clinical decision

safety.disclaimer_required: Operational coordination aid for volunteer logistics only; not a medical record system and offers no clinical decision support or guidance.
